description_en: ListCustomAgent returns a list of all custom agents from the personal space and workspaces
description_zh: ListCustomAgent 获取个人空间、工作空间中所有自定义Agent列表
kebab_example: aliyun dms list-custom-agent --workspace-id 56kv1pvl9uvt90000000000bb --search-key '测试Agent' --status RELEASED --query-all-released true --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCustomAgent

parameters.help_en: A keyword for a fuzzy search on the names and descriptions of custom agents
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，支持自定义Agent名称和描述模糊搜索
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en: The status of the custom agent
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query all published custom agents. The default value is false
parameters.help_zh: 查询所有已发布状态的自定义Agent，默认为false
parameters.name: query_all_released

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The page size. The default value is 20
parameters.name: page_size
